name: Nanchang Changbei International Airport
before:
Jiangxi's main airport, 28 km north of Nanchang, and busier than its profile suggests. It handled just under 12 million passengers in 2025 across some 92,000 aircraft movements, both up on the year before.

It opened in September 1999 after three years of construction, replacing the older Xiangtang airport, which had run out of room after growing from a hundred passengers in its first year to more than 800,000 by 1996. An upgrade to international status and a substantial expansion followed between 2008 and 2011.

For anyone planning a route into this part of central China it is worth knowing this is the province's single gateway rather than one of several, so schedules concentrate here.
after:
The airport for Nanchang, the capital of Jiangxi, 28 km north of the city. It handled just under 12 million passengers in 2025 across some 92,000 aircraft movements, both up on the year before.

Changbei opened in September 1999, replacing the older Xiangtang airport.
